findings.text: the completion-acceptance case asserts only that dispatch returned, not that the acceptance returned it: if the supervisor's launch exceeds SUPERVISOR_SURVIVAL_SECONDS (2 s, and the plan records a degraded filesystem at 30 s per tree), dispatch returns on its deadline, the case still passes green and the acceptance, with the negative control that reddens it, stops covering the fix at exactly the moment it matters; bound the dispatch process's elapsed time below the survival window, or pin the return to the record read, so a green pass is evidence the acceptance ran.

the manifest names the red log the adjudication asked for, but the run record's node.write_paths still names no test path, so promotion's negative-control reader exempts this run as "node-writes-no-test-path" and never opens logs/negative-control.log: the mutation evidence for the two test files is delivered but unenforced, and the recorded declaration ("revert the fix; test_dispatch_returns_once_its_supervisor_runs then fails with the supervisor exiting within 2 s") no longer names the mutation the log records.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 57ccb6fe; 0dfdddf18 took the fenced supervisor's baseline back to the full registry, 377dba269 landed the fragment, and fa2ca1cb8 undid that revert and added _supervisor_launched_worker (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6454) plus the acceptance in _confirm_supervisor_survived (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6496), leaving the net dispatch.py diff the survival acceptance with the fenced fact carried again through _supervisor_spec at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:5050 and 6788.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a logged base repro, five isolated passes, the boundary file, the declared negative control and -n 8 arms over the dispatch-importing files; logs/base-repro.log (1 failed, EXIT=1, traceback at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6469), logs/head-iso-1..5.log (5 passed, EXIT=0), logs/head-boundary-9of9.log (9 passed), logs/negative-control.log (1 failed, EXIT=1) and the manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite (both 142 passed, 0 failed) satisfy all but the arm population, because the -n 8 arm was killed at EXIT=124 at about 66 percent and the manifest's suite fields carry the adjudicated bounded 8-file arms instead.
item_verdicts.goal: read the node goal (dispatch returns once its supervisor runs again, keeping the two-tree boundary scan) against head fa2ca1cb8; the survival check now returns on the supervisor's completion exit record (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6496) and the fenced supervisor's baseline reads the run's own worktree and the main checkout again (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6952), which I confirmed by re-running the named case in scratch trees: 1 failed EXIT=1 at base 57ccb6fe and 1 passed EXIT=0 at head.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete with commits 0dfdddf18, 377dba269 and fa2ca1cb8, a landing line, literal test commands and results, test_logs, negative_control_log with its note, measurement_module and measurement_cwd, baseline_suite and after_suite as JSON with real log paths and exit_status 0, follow_ons naming the aborted -n 8 arm, and blockers none.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the adjudicated scope (resume-1-advice.txt:5, reckon/crew/dispatch.py and the two test files) covers every path in the diff, but the run record's node.write_paths still names the pre-adjudication set, so reckon crew check-manifest --run r-20260930T070700513900-supervisor-survives-the-two-tree-snapshot reports exactly one finding, "changed paths outside the write scope: tests/test_boundary_check_reads_two_trees.py, tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py", which I reproduced by running that command.

justifications.durability: the acceptance is guarded by a case the logged mutation reddens (tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py:1365, logs/negative-control.log 1 failed EXIT=1) and the two-tree baseline by a case driving the supervisor's own spec (tests/test_boundary_check_reads_two_trees.py:231), but the acceptance case bounds nothing about how dispatch returned, so it can pass with the acceptance never read.
justifications.evidence: every figure the done_when names is on disk with a header and an EXIT record and the manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite resolve to logs/subarm-base.log and logs/subarm-head.log where the project's own reader gives 0 added failures, but those arms are the adjudication's bounded 8-file pair rather than the done_when's -n 8 arm over the dispatch-importing files, which aborted at EXIT=124 and survives only as a follow_on.
justifications.fit: the change reads like its immediate neighbours and adds no lint or format finding (ruff check reports the same seven findings over the three paths at base and head), though _confirm_supervisor_survived now returns a run id that neither call site (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6824, 6835) reads.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the landed change does what the goal states, returning a dispatch whose supervisor reached its run (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6496) while a fenced supervisor's baseline reads two trees again through _supervisor_tree_snapshot (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:6959), and I reproduced the pair in scratch trees /tmp/rev-mc/base (1 failed, EXIT=1) and /tmp/rev-mc/head (1 passed, EXIT=0).
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is inside the adjudicated scope named at resume-1-advice.txt:5 with nothing beyond it, but the run record's write paths are the pre-adjudication set, so reckon crew check-manifest reports one finding and promotion needs crew complete --accept-path for the two test files.
